sentences.target: '-(으)ㄹ지언정'은 강하게 양보하거나 극단적으로 대비되는 상황을 표현할 때 사용한다.
sentences.en: This form is used to express a strong concession or contrast.

sentences.target: 앞 절의 조건이나 상황을 인정하면서도 뒤 절의 의지나 결론을 강조한다.
sentences.en: The speaker acknowledges the condition in the first clause while emphasizing the final intention in the second.

sentences.target: 주로 부정적이거나 힘든 상황을 받아들이는 뉘앙스로 쓰인다.
sentences.en: It often carries the nuance of accepting something difficult or unfavorable.

sentences.target: 문어적이고 강조적 표현으로 일상 대화에서는 자주 사용되지 않는다.
sentences.en: It appears mainly in formal or written contexts, not in casual conversation.

sentences.target: 주어의 의지가 강하게 드러날 때 자주 쓰이는 형태이다.
sentences.en: It is frequently used when the subject’s determination is emphasized.

sentences.target: 현실적으로 어려운 상황이어도 목적이나 결심을 바꾸지 않음을 나타낸다.
sentences.en: It shows that even if the situation is difficult, the speaker’s purpose does not change.

sentences.target: 형용사와 동사 모두에 결합할 수 있으나 동사 결합이 더 흔하다.
sentences.en: It can be used with both verbs and adjectives, though verbs are more common.

sentences.target: 과거 상황에 대해서도 화자의 판단을 강조할 때 사용할 수 있다.
sentences.en: It can refer to past situations when the speaker expresses a firm judgment.

sentences.target: 앞 절은 부정적·불리한 조건, 뒤 절은 긍정적·강한 의지 구조가 일반적이다.
sentences.en: The first clause typically presents a disadvantage, while the second presents a firm stance.

sentences.target: 조건을 양보하더라도 최종 결과나 태도가 흔들리지 않음을 드러내는 표현이다.
sentences.en: It highlights that the final decision or attitude does not waver despite the concession.
Even if it is hard, I will not give up.
I may be late, but I will keep my promise.
Even if I take a loss, I will not change my decision.
It may be insufficient, but it contains sincerity.
It may be inconvenient, but the principle must be kept.
Even if it is difficult, I will give it a try.
It may be inefficient, but it is the safest method.
It may be far, but I will go check it myself.
It may take time, but I will complete it properly.
I may be criticized, but I will not hide the truth.
It may seem impossible, but I will do my best.
I may be tired, but I will finish it today.
Even if I am alone, I did not lose focus.
I may not be understood, but I followed my choice.
I may be isolated, but I did not abandon my principles.

sentences.target: 실패할지언정 한 번은 도전해 보고 싶었다.
sentences.en: I may fail, but I wanted to try at least once.
It may be unfamiliar, but I accepted the new environment.
It may be unfavorable, but I did not compromise.
It may be harsh, but it was a necessary judgment.
It may be unrealistic, but I did not lose hope.
